description: Make or change Rain (rain/): a figure under an umbrella, cut dark out of a flat sky, dots of light flowing over their form, in a rain of written characters that trail rings, break on the canopy, run off its rim and lie down where they land. Use for a new person or pose, a palette, a set of characters, an umbrella that sits wrong, dots that jitter instead of flow, rain too thin or too thick, or a stage that runs slow, even if the user never says "skill".
